newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD upgraded to buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it has upgraded its recommendation on Brazilian mining giant Cia Vale do Rio Doce to buy from hold and raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates for the firm.
Analyst Mauricio Reveco said in a report he has raised his 1997 earnings forecast for the firm to $1.61 per share from $1.49 and his 1998 forecast to $1.84 a share from $1.66.
"We (also) are raising CVRD's weight in our model Latin American portfolio from 0.6 percent to 2.9 percent, resulting in an overweight of 1.2 percent," he wrote.
To make room for CVRD, Salomon Brothers has reduced the weight of Petrobras BR Distribuidora to zero from 2.3 percent, he added.
CVRD's blue chip preferred closed Wednesday at 25 reais, up 1.2 percent from the prior session, while its common closed flat at 26 reais on the Sao Paulo bourse.
